title: heai-tools tasks configuration
description: tasks.yaml, beside a tracker's items/: the one part of a tracker that is about the repository rather than the tasks. Every key is optional and an absent file is an empty configuration. tools/tasks/README.md is the specification.

map.title: a path
map.description: The architecture map whose territories `territory` may name, and from which each territory's owner is read. Relative to the tracker directory. Without it, `territory` accepts any non-empty value.
